title: Protocol Optimization: From 40% Yield to 85%
excerpt: How systematically varying one parameter at a time transformed our organoid-electrode coupling efficiency.
body: Six months ago, our organoid-electrode coupling yield sat around 40%. Today it's approaching 85%. Here's what changed.
Not all organoids form clean spheroids. Some are irregular, some clump together, and some don't attach well to our mesh. We needed a way to handle variability without discarding too many samples.
I built a simple experiment matrix in Python to track variables. The key finding: matrigel concentration matters most. Optimal concentration is 2.5 mg/mL (vs. our old 4 mg/mL).

Warning
Lower matrigel = more fragile organoids. Handle with extra care during transfer.
Optimizing one variable at a time is slow but necessary. The literature gives you starting points, not final answers. Your organoids, your protocols, your results.
